verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a dedicated SOC 2 offering. It automates the SOC 2 process at every step and condenses 200+ controls into 8 key steps. It also provides policy templates written and approved by former auditors, and automates evidence collection through 100+ integrations. Missing for 10: explicit Type I vs Type II program support, explicit mapping to the Trust Services Criteria, documentation of built-in auditor evidence-request workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
